build_recipe.lockfile_policy: Cargo.lock must exist and its SHA-256 is recorded in later build evidence; --locked forbids resolution drift
build_recipe.source_and_dockerfile_policy: Later build evidence records Git SHA, Cargo.lock SHA-256, Dockerfile SHA-256, and all resolved image index/platform digests

clean_pull_evidence.redaction: no credentials, DSNs, tokens, raw driver errors, source rows, absolute host paths, or environment values

faults.hook_policy: later executors inject only at named fixture phases; M0 records no runtime result

health.success: all three commands exit 0 before the 120 second readiness deadline

later_executors.boring-cdc-m0-scaffold: Compose path, exact image/tool/build input validation, clean pull, health and readiness evidence
later_executors.boring-cdc-m6-failure-matrix: partition, restart, zombie, stale-completion and dependency-delay execution
later_executors.boring-cdc-m7-artifacts: actual connector/release image digest and immutable build-output evidence

ownership.equality_policy: a measured reap of exactly 70 seconds passes; takeover may not start before 90 elapsed seconds absent clean-release read-back proof
successor_requirements: acquire local and PostgreSQL advisory locks
ownership.uncertain_ownership: fence dispatch and exit nonzero; never reacquire in process

purpose: Mechanically freeze M0 Compose/build inputs and recovery fixtures without implementing runtime behavior or requiring an unbuilt connector digest.

toolchain.host_requirement: Linux amd64; exact tool versions are recorded and checked by the clean-pull executor

upgrade_policy.digest_change: rerun clean-pull, readiness, compatibility, and rollback checks; old digest remains rollback target only when store compatibility is proved
upgrade_policy.patch_minor: requires the clean-pull fixture and a rollback-compatible store before digest replacement
upgrade_policy.postgres_clickhouse_major: requires a fresh source/destination migration plan and re-seed; never automatic
